title: Valid guest name with an initial ("R. Chandra") rejected as NAME_CHARS
root_cause: Name regex allowed exactly one separator between letter groups, so the two-character sequence '. ' after an initial failed.
fix: Separator group extended to accept '. ' (dot followed by space); regression test kept in suite.

title: Booking form inputs overflow their grid columns (Extra beds field spills outside the card)
found_by: Exploratory session XS-02 (visual review of TC-E2E-001 screenshot 05_paid.png)
root_cause: Number inputs keep their intrinsic min-width inside CSS grid cells; no width:100% / min-width:0.
fix: input,select{width:100%;min-width:0}; regression test TC-E2E-014 asserts every field stays inside its card.
steps: Open home at 1280px, sign in, select DELUXE
actual_before_fix: Extra beds and Children inputs overflow the right edge by ~45 px

title: Quote panel shows '₹-0.00' when the discount is zero
found_by: Exploratory session XS-02 (visual review of screenshot 04_quote.png)
root_cause: UI negated the discount (-q.discount) for display; -0 formats as '-0.00' in toLocaleString.
fix: Display discount as '− ₹x' only when > 0, otherwise '₹0.00'; regression test TC-E2E-015.
steps: Get price for a stay with no discount

title: Booking endpoint p95 latency 663 ms under 25 concurrent users exceeds the 300 ms SLA
root_cause: SQLite default rollback journal serialises writers and fsyncs on every commit; BEGIN IMMEDIATE + payment commit per booking amplifies contention.
fix: Enable WAL journal mode with synchronous=NORMAL for file databases; re-measured with the same seeded workload.
actual_before_fix: book p95 = 663.2 ms, overall p95 = 213.5 ms

title: Test-suite defect: DOM-XSS test exercised a path that never reflects input, so an innerHTML regression went undetected
root_cause: Test designed against the login error, which is a constant message; the promo-code error is the real reflection point.
fix: TC-E2E-003 Rev B attacks the promo path and asserts the payload is shown literally; seeded fault SF-11 now detected.
